sources.pe: HARP revised Section V and rebuttal D2: 16 HCC × 64 SIMD-8 PEs.
sources.vector: HARP revised Section VI: two SIMD-32 datapaths per HCC.
sources.memory: HARP revised Section VI: 64 MiB global plus 16×2 MiB local, 2.4 TB/s. The graph allocator treats capacity as pooled.
sources.plane_formation: Four pipelines/HCC per Section V, with an assumed one Slice issued per pipeline cycle.
sources.algorithm: HARP revised Section VI-D: average selected Region fraction 32.66%, natural skipped planes 21.46%, final skipped planes 50.68%, fallback 0.50% for 4×4 Regions. Average values are transferred to workload templates, including structural proxies.
sources.active_component_fraction: Provisional 2/32 active components per retained numeric plane; required separately from plane counts to map to issue units.
sources.issue_utilization: Representative Slice utilization from rebuttal GC1 and Figure 9(b), used as an initial sustained-rate proxy for sparse work.
sources.other_rates: Packet, multicast, region-control and shift-reduction rates are first reconstruction assumptions, not RTL measurements.
sources.qk_issue: Section V-B Plane–Plane uses one retained plane pair per 32-channel Slice; edge slices round up; no additional joint-zero pruning is assumed.
